ops.text: uv sync in a git worktree silently reused a STALE cached native build of cc-transcript (same version 13.0.0, different source tree): the freshly rebased p2-ids worktree synced "green" but _parser_rs lacked the just-landed command_parse symbol, failing 60 parity tests with AttributeError. Plain `uv sync` is not a rebuild guarantee for path deps across worktrees — `--reinstall-package cc-transcript` fixed it instantly. Every v14 lane gate that syncs a worktree venv needs --reinstall-package cc-transcript (or a version-suffix bump) before trusting pytest results; the release-mechanics memory's --refresh-package note covers registry CDN lag, this is the local-path sibling of the same trap.
